competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times using its gigantic body and recovers the HP in proportion to the number of enemies under the [Electric Shock] effect.

Attacks the enemies in the frontline 2 times with a sharp thorn. The damage increases substantially as the target's Defense decreases. This attack will target the backline if there are no enemies left in the frontline.

Attacks all enemies 3 times with a furious roar and grants the [Electric Shock] Effect. The damage increases and ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken every time the Lightning Roar is used.
Removes all beneficial effects on all enemies and attacks them 6 times with wind breath to inflict damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.
